subject: Day 1: build a repeatable 10-deal habit
preheader: Analyze 10 deals with consistent targets to learn which assumptions matter most.
headline: You have full Pro. Here's the one habit that matters.
body: Welcome to your trial. Eligible Pro features include the target-dependent Offer Ceiling, Buy Box rule fit, the downside stress test, comparisons, and reports designed for review with your advisers or lender.

One useful practice is to analyze 10 deals using the same rules. Repetition can expose which assumptions and criteria need refinement. Review the pricing and terms pages for current trial, renewal, cancellation, and refund terms.

For each property: review the inputs, check the selected-rule fit, note the Offer Ceiling and its target profile, then verify the assumptions that could change the result. The Offer Ceiling is not a recommended offer.
signature_note: The full path from screening to a submitted offer is written down at usetruecap.com/playbook.
